description: This is a PHP test class for the OAuthClientAPI, containing unit tests for methods like getAll, update, getOne, and delete within the OAuth API. It uses PHPUnit and custom utility classes for testing OAuth client API endpoints in the OrangeHRM project.

classes.name: OAuthClientAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the OAuthClientAPI endpoints such as getAll, update, getOne, and delete. It extends EndpointIntegrationTestCase and contains data providers for test cases.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of all OAuth clients via the API, using data provider for different test cases.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test cases for testing the getAll API method.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating an OAuth client, mocking generateSecret and using test case parameters.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestUpdate
methods.description: Provides test cases for updating OAuth clients.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests fetching a single OAuth client by ID.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetOne
methods.description: Provides test cases for retrieving a single OAuth client.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests deletion of an OAuth client.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestDelete
methods.description: Provides test cases for deleting OAuth clients.
